title: Coverage Bulletin: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, Built-In Transportation Expense and Storage
content:
**Coverage position.** Cardinal Rental Reimbursement and the built-in transportation expense of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage are never added together on one loss.

| The damaged vehicle carries | Benefit that applies to the loss |
|---|---|
| A rental reimbursement option | The option pays. The built-in transportation expense does not apply. |
| No rental reimbursement option | Only the built-in transportation expense applies. |

## Damage to the rental car

Damage to the rental car itself is not paid under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement. It is handled under the vehicle's own physical damage as a non-owned car, where the option provides that physical damage extends to the rental car, and it is subject to that coverage's deductible.

## Storage

While the vehicle's physical damage is in storage, the option is suspended. No rental is authorized for a loss during storage.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical situations)

- *A vehicle carrying 50/1500 is damaged, and the customer asks to add the built-in transportation expense on top of the option.* The two are never added together on one loss. The option pays.
- *A rental car is scraped while the customer has it.* The scrape is not a rental reimbursement payment. It falls under the customer's own vehicle's physical damage as a non-owned car, less that coverage's deductible.
- *A loss occurs while the vehicle's physical damage is laid up in storage.* The option is suspended, and no rental is authorized for that loss.
